ocean: Open ocean ambience on an offshore platform, waves, steady wind, distant seagulls
hum: Powerful futuristic elevator capsule accelerating upward, electric motor hum rising in pitch, smooth, cinematic
wind: High altitude wind rushing past a moving capsule, airy whoosh fading as air gets thinner
pass: Large space station gliding past very close, deep soft cinematic whoosh with low rumble
glass: Single delicate glass clink, then a soft eerie floating shimmer
creak: Huge steel cable under extreme tension, deep metallic creaking and groaning, strain
snap: Massive steel cable snapping violently, whip crack and metal ping with deep reverb
micro: Delicate glittering microscopic science shimmer, crystalline, futuristic and soft
